provenance: AUTHORED BY THE TUNER AFTER READING THE CORPUS. This set is NOT held out. The in-domain queries were written with knowledge of what the index contains, which inflates their lexical coverage relative to queries written blind. It is retained only so the bands quoted in README.md and src/core/config.ts are reproducible, and it must not be used to support a demonstrated claim. See ../vector-topology-primitives/canonical/CLAIMS.md row C11.
corpus: this repository, indexed at the recorded commit

queries: how does the disambiguation gate work
how do I bake sourdough bread
what is the capital of Peru
how to change a car tire
retired.reason: Retired 2026-08-29. tests/production_regressions.ts asserts tokenizeQuery on this exact sentence, and src/retrieval/lexical.ts discusses "tire" in a comment, so the repository's own source now contains the query text. It is no longer unanswerable on this corpus and the gate was right to answer it. The general rule: a self-indexing repository cannot use text that appears in its own indexed source as a negative, and the same trap took research/disambiguation-gate/generate_queries.ts -- the negative vocabulary generator -- which is now in excludedPathPrefixes. This is an argument for C11's existing promotion rule, which requires replication on a second corpus.
